summary: Today features significant legal rulings and retail developments, with the Calcutta High Court and Kerala High Court making notable judgments.

bullets.text: Calcutta High Court permits Chhath Puja worship on private property, affirming devotees' rights.
Kerala High Court designates BJP leader Sreedharan Pillai as Senior Advocate suo motu.
Madras High Court questions eligibility of Brahmins for OBC quota upon converting to Christianity.
ITC Foods’ Right Shift achieves 300% growth, plans to expand its nutrition portfolio with quarterly launches.
Bodhi Tree Investment invests $180 million in A2B to fund expansion and digital upgrades across 160 outlets.
